facts.fact: StackAdapt's guide recommends checking programmatic campaign results mid-flight, at a minimum of 1 week after the campaign goes live.
facts.quote: Check on the results of your campaign mid-flight, or a minimum of 1 week after your campaign goes live.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's guide says a short-term campaign running less than 3 months will likely require a more frequent reporting cadence.
facts.quote: a short-term campaign running less than 3 months will likely require a more frequent cadence for reporting.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's guide lists the most common programmatic reporting cadences as daily, weekly, mid-month, and monthly.
facts.quote: The most common cadences for programmatic reporting are:

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's guide, a typical weekly programmatic report covers the previous Monday to Sunday.
facts.quote: Weekly (Typically the previous Monday to Sunday)

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's guide, a typical mid-month programmatic report includes data up until the 15th of the month.
facts.quote: Mid-Month (Typically includes data up until the 15th of the month)

facts.fact: StackAdapt's guide advises making only one change at a time when optimizing mid-flight so that performance changes can be attributed to a specific action.
facts.quote: it’s best practice to make only one change at a time.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's guide names Supermetrics, Funnel, and Ninjacat as reporting software that can consolidate all digital spend into one platform.
facts.quote: Leverage reporting software like Supermetrics, Funnel, or Ninjacat, that will enable you to amalgamate all of your digital spend into one platform.
